content:
**Built memory:ship (#888, slice B): the ship op dispatched before backend selection, BRAIN_MEMORY_TOKEN read once into the port identity, --dry-run and --json; triggers deferred to #889**

**What**: Added the ship op to brain/scripts/memory/cli.mjs (dispatched before backend selection like collect; reads BRAIN_MEMORY_TOKEN exactly once and passes it as the port identity, absent means ambient; --dry-run makes zero calls of its own; --json carries the outcome shape; exit-code table: nothing-to-ship and shipped 0, diverged and mrList/mrCreate failures non-zero, every mrAutoMerge refusal 0; raced and badHost pass through), fourteen memory.ship.* i18n keys in en and es, package.json memory:ship, a test seam BRAIN_VCS_TEST_MODULE constrained by real path to the committed brain/scripts/memory/__fixtures__/ directory with a data-driven fake port (fake-vcs-port.mjs driven by a JSON script), and shipLane fixes: title and body computed only when a push or PR happens (null on nothing-to-ship), mrAutoMerge throws mapped to a non-fatal refusal.

**Why**: Wave 3 slice 3.1b of #864 under ADR-0034 L1/L2/L5; PR 2 of the #888 split (library in #901, PR #902). Ruling D4 deferred the SessionEnd hook and the day:start sweep to #889 because settings.json is compiler-emitted with a shared drift test and issue-link refuses a lane PR until #889 lands; pre-push non-invocation is pinned.

**Where**: brain/scripts/memory/cli.mjs, cli.ship.test.mjs, __fixtures__/fake-vcs-port.mjs, lane/ship.mjs, ship.test.mjs; brain/scripts/i18n/{en,es}.mjs; package.json; openspec/changes/issue-888-lane-ship/**; epic task 3.1b ticked.

**Learned**: the first version of the seam imported an arbitrary absolute path from the environment in the process holding the token; a fresh review executed an injected module that read it. The fix is containment to committed code (real path, symlinks resolved, blank value refused) and a fixture that only reads data. Four CLI tests had been binding the real port through getVcs without invoking it; every CLI test now runs through the seam and a source guard pins it. A test fixture that computes today's date separately from the CLI can straddle UTC midnight and fall through to the real port; the diverged test now asserts the ref it expects.
